[[Pallet Town]] |scheme=Johto |pub1=Comic mook |pub1-data=Special chapter 2 in [[Pokémon the Comic]] }} (Japanese: '''シロガネ山修業編 《後編》''' ''The {{tt|Mt. Shirogane|Mt. Silver}} Training Chapter (Part 2)'') is the second special chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga taking place during {{adv|Red}} and {{adv|Gold}}'s training on [[Mt. Silver]]. This chapter was first published in [[Pokémon the Comic]] on June 7, 2013, and was the result of Red and [[Pika]] respectively winning the human and Pokémon sections on the 2011 Netkun popularity poll. ==Plot== {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{adv|Red}} and [[Pika]] battle the wild {{p|Poliwrath}} and {{p|Venusaur}} that kidnapped [[Pibu]]. * Due to their high [[level]] and being same species as [[Poli]] and [[Saur]], Pika has trouble facing his opponents. * After calming down, Red has Pika defeat the two Pokémon and rescue Pibu. * Sometime later, Red reveals that the Super Rising Thunder technique Pibu used to defeat [[Pryce]] is actually named {{m|Volt Tackle}}. * To help master the technique, Red lends {{adv|Gold}} his gloves. * Red and Pika go off to meet up with {{adv|Blue}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} * {{adv|Gold}} * [[Lt. Surge]] (on book) * [[Wattson]] (on book) * [[Radio Director|Hirō]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Poliwrath}} ([[Poli]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Politoed}} ([[Polibo]]/{{tt|Poltaro|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Pichu}} ([[Pibu]]; {{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Poliwrath}} * {{p|Venusaur}} * {{p|Pikachu}} (on book) * {{p|Pichu}} (on book) * {{p|Raichu}} (on book) * {{p|Plusle}} (on book) * {{p|Minun}} (on book) * {{p|Pachirisu}} (on book) * {{p|Emolga}} (on book) * {{p|Charizard}} (on poster) ==Trivia== * {{adv|Red}} reveals that the {{p|Charizard}} poster in his room was given to him from a friend overseas, revealing that Pokémon have different names in other locations. * Blue Sky Masters {{tt|Abbot Clef and Costello Jiggly|Pippin and Purin in the Chuang Yi translation}} appear on Red's TV. * Several plot elements are revealed in this chapter. ** Red's gloves are revealed to have an invisible lining to make it look like they're fingerless. This removes the plot hole as to why Red and [[Lt. Surge]] weren't shocked despite their fingers appearing to be unprotected from electricity. ** The technique {{adv|Gold}} called "Super Rising Thunder" is actually the move {{m|Volt Tackle}}. ** The virus that would later grow into {{adv|Deoxys|Organisms No. 1 and No. 2}} are discovered in the [[Mossdeep Space Center]]. {{PrevNext |prev=PSs1 |next=None |list=Pokémon Adventures special chapters |colorscheme=Johto}} {{Project Manga notice}} [[Category:Pokémon Adventures chapters]] [[es:EPMS02]] [[it:PSs2]] [[zh:白银山修行篇（下篇）]]
